## Specific task description

Task instruction: Stack the light blue bowl with darkened rim directly over the light blue bowl with darkened rim.

Task description: Stack the two bowls with dark rims at the left and right of the image on top of the light-blue bowl; either can be the bottom bowl.

Success criteria: The lower bowl must rest on the table and support the upper bowl nested inside its opening. Their bodies must approximately align horizontally, forming a low stack near the table. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping an unobstructed wall section below the rim, with one finger inside and one against the outside. Match the opening to wall thickness and entry clearance, avoiding spanning the entire mouth.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on the inside and outside of the same section of bowl wall, with the pads covering the wall rather than pressing only on the thin rim, to avoid a missed grasp, slipping, or tipping the bowl.
- Keep the bowl opening up during transport, with enough bottom clearance to cross the lower rim. Use open space at the table center for pose adjustment to reduce sweeping collisions with bottles, cans, and the trophy behind.
- When lowering the upper bowl, aim its bottom into the lower bowl's opening and watch clearance between the outside finger and lower rim. Release only after the lower bowl supports it, then withdraw upward to avoid trapping fingers between walls or displacing the upper bowl.
